component.name: Gitloom
component.summary: Native, open-source Git client with a GitKraken-style interface

description.p: A fast Git client with the layout, interactions and keyboard shortcuts long-time GitKraken users know: lane graph, staging by file, hunk and line, branches and remotes, merge, rebase and conflict resolution, undo and redo. Native Rust, no webview, no accounts, no telemetry.
